serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #mrsfisher.Face.Normal #bot.Expression.Clear Mrs. Fisher: Look who we have here. You: Oh, it’s you, Mrs. Fisher. #mrsfisher.Face.Grin #bot.Expression.Happy Mrs. Fisher: I see you brought your missus with you. #mrsfisher.Face.Normal You: This is Mrs. Fisher. She’s the one who got me hooked on fishing. Bot: Hi! My name is {f_botName}, nice to meet you! Mrs. Fisher: Hello there. #mrsfisher.Eyes.AngryClosed+mrsfisher.Mouth.Normal Mrs. Fisher: To think I would live to see the day when my student became a master…{{wi}} How incredibly lucky am I? You: Come on, you aren’t that old… #mrsfisher.Face.Normal Mrs. Fisher: It’s good to see the younger generation picking up their rods. Over the years it was always just old guys, especially around these areas. At some point I thought fishing would die out. You: Now you’ve got us. Mrs. Fisher: So, missus. Are you enjoying fishing? Bot: Very much so! I started recently and I still have a lot to learn, but it’s been a good time. Mrs. Fisher: That’s good to hear. #mrsfisher.Face.Grin Mrs. Fisher: For a second there I was afraid that he was forcing you into this. Bot: Of course not! I wanted to try it out. Mrs. Fisher: Good, good. Mrs. Fisher: I will be going now, I don’t want to spoil your precious time together. You: Thank you for coming by. Bot: It was a pleasure meeting you! Mrs. Fisher: Have fun!
